text: Acceptance [Lat. acceptatio ]. Recommended to replace the word recognition, sometimes used as translation of the German Anerkennen (-ung). Cf. Hegel's use of Anerkennung in his Philos . of Mind ; and Eisler, Wörterb . d . philos . Begriffe , sub verbo. ( J.M.B. )
